summary: Iteration 44: Comprehensive testing of 4-step hierarchical approval chain for Lessons and Schemes of Work. All 13 backend tests PASSED. The approval chain enforces: HeadOfAcademics (Step 1) -> Principal (Step 2) -> CEO (Step 3) -> Founder (Step 4). CRITICAL BUG FIX VERIFIED: CEO (who holds HeadOfAcademics role) is correctly blocked from approving at Step 1 and can only approve at Step 3 (their highest step in the chain).

issues: HTML hydration warnings: <th>/<td>/<tr> cannot be child of <span>. This is a React rendering issue but doesn't affect functionality.

passed_tests: Backend: Teacher creates lesson (POST /api/lessons-v2/) - status 200, returns draft
Backend: Teacher submits lesson (POST /api/lessons-v2/{id}/submit) - creates 4-step approval chain
Backend: HeadTeacher sees submitted lesson in my-pending-reviews at Step 1
Backend: CEO does NOT see lesson at Step 1 (chain-aware role enforcement)
Backend: CEO cannot approve at Step 1 - returns 403 Forbidden
Backend: HeadTeacher approves Step 1 - lesson moves to Principal (Step 2)
Backend: CEO still cannot approve at Step 2 - returns 403
Backend: Principal approves Step 2 - lesson moves to CEO (Step 3)
Backend: CEO can now see lesson in my-pending-reviews at Step 3
Backend: CEO approves Step 3 - lesson moves to Founder (Step 4)
Backend: Founder gives final approval - lesson status becomes 'approved'
Backend: HeadTeacher can return a lesson - status becomes 'returned'
Backend: Scheme of Work has identical approval chain flow
Frontend: Teacher login and navigation to Lessons works
Frontend: Teacher can create and submit lessons
Frontend: ApprovalChainBadge shows colored dots (green=approved, gray=pending)
Frontend: HeadTeacher has 'Lesson Approvals' sidebar link
Frontend: Lesson Approvals page shows Pending/Approved/Returned counts
